say:2:1410908001:1.text: That sound! It's the dragon... It's flying away!

say:4:1410908002:1.text: It came from the square! I need to see what's happening!
say:4:1410908002:1.source_cn: 声音从广场那边传来！我得去看看……

say:5:1410908003:1.text: With the queen dead, the statue she held together with magic would've shattered. Sal'thorin will be plunged into chaos after the citizens see that.
say:5:1410908003:1.source_cn: 女王一旦崩逝，她用魔力维系的女王雕像也会随之破碎，萨洛...

say:6:1410908004:1.text: I understand, Indris, but you just killed her... It's too dangerous to go there now!
say:6:1410908004:1.source_cn: 因度厄！你的意思我懂，但你刚刚杀了……这时候过去也太危险了！

say:7:1410908005:1.text: That's why I need to go there even more.

say:8:1410908006:1.text: The guards need to maintain order and calm the people.
say:8:1410908006:1.source_cn: 卫队需要维持秩序，安抚民众。哪怕……

say:9:1410908007:1.text: Stop being so stubborn! What if you get caught when you get there?!
say:9:1410908007:1.source_cn: 你这个死脑筋！现在过去要是被抓了可怎么办！

say:10:1410908008:1.text: I am Indris, Captain of the Sal'thorin Guard. Before I'm relieved of my duties...
say:10:1410908008:1.source_cn: 我是因度厄，萨洛克兰的卫队长。在我的职务尚未被解除之前——

say:11:1410908009:1.text: ...I'll never hide when the people need me, not when it matters the most!
say:11:1410908009:1.source_cn: 我绝不会在民众最需要的时候躲藏！

choice_prompt:12:1410908009.text: ...I'll never hide when the people need me, not when it matters the most!
choice_prompt:12:1410908009.source_cn: 我绝不会在民众最需要的时候躲藏！

say:13:1410908010:1.text: Ha! I can't believe he said that with a straight face. It sounded pretty cool though... Alright, I'm in!
say:13:1410908010:1.source_cn: 哇……你都这么说了，我们还能怎么办？好吧，加我一个！
say:13:1410908010:1.male: Ha! I can't believe he said that with a straight face. It sounded pretty cool though... Alright, I'm in!
say:13:1410908010:1.female: Ha! I can't believe he said that with a straight face. It sounded pretty cool though... Alright, I'm in!

say:14:1410908011:1.text: But if the situation turns on us, we make a run for it!
say:14:1410908011:1.source_cn: 情况不妙的话，要赶快溜哦！
